newsitem.title: USA: Centra makes offer for Powerhouse UK shrs.
newsitem.headline: Centra makes offer for Powerhouse UK shrs.

text.p: Centra Capital Corporation Inc said Monday it will make an offer for all of the outstanding share capital of Powerhouse Resources Inc held by shareholders in the United Kingdom.
It said the offer will be in the form of a U.S. dollar redeemable convertible share issue by Centra.
It did not provide figures for the offer and a company contact did not immediately return a call for further information.
A statement from Centra said the company's offer came in light of the delisting of Colorado-based Powerhouse's shares on the U.K. and the U.S. exchanges.

Centra said in its statement that it has been talking to Powerhouse chief executive Anil Kunmar to obtain an analysis of the outstanding share capital, list of shareholders and other company information.
It said the Powerhouse board has refused to provide any information, but that it plans to proceed with the offer.

"It must be noted that in the light of uncertainty created by the absence of the information ... the offer is likely to be on terms which are significantly less attractive to PRI shareholders," the Centra statement said.
The company said Ellis & Partners Ltd has told it that subject to certain conditions it will recommend acceptance of the offer to Powerhouse shareholders who are their clients.
